position: A reviewer plan is not an account, credential, identity-provider session, or invitation
headline: The runbook defines who may review, for how long, and under whose sponsorship before identity is connected.
copy: Every planned reviewer stays pseudonymous, time-bounded, privately sponsored, consented, and unable to publish, invite, or activate the product.

postures.title: Provisioning planner
postures.copy: Role, assurance, consent, expiry, and identity rules are executable.

postures.title: Direct identity
postures.copy: Email, name, phone, address, password, and token fields are rejected.

postures.title: Pilot scale
postures.copy: The runbook cannot silently expand the reviewer cohort.

postures.title: Accounts
postures.copy: The planner returns no credential or live identity.

flow.title: Constrain
flow.copy: Choose a bounded role, AAL2, consent, and expiry.

flow.title: Provision later
flow.copy: Create nothing until a reviewed identity provider exists.

decisions.label: Roles
decisions.reason: Observer, source, rights, and release review remain separate.

decisions.label: Created accounts
decisions.reason: This release is a runbook and validator only.

locks.title: Credential lock
locks.copy: No secret value or reviewer credential is generated.

locks.title: Provider lock
locks.copy: No external account, runtime, endpoint, or domain is created.

locks.title: Invitation lock
locks.copy: The decision surfaces cannot issue an invitation.

locks.title: Participant lock
locks.copy: No external participant or public session exists.

locks.title: Public launch lock
locks.copy: Private implementation evidence cannot open public launch.
